brains.title: Brains
brains.intro: A brain is the AI your agent thinks with. Set up one or more; each agent picks a main brain and a backup.

desc.claude: Anthropic's Claude Code app, with your Claude account
desc.codex: OpenAI's Codex app, with your ChatGPT account
desc.opencode: Free model, no key, no payment. Good to start
desc.gemini: Google's Gemini CLI, with your Google account
desc.grok: xAI's Grok CLI, with an xAI key
desc.local: Ollama or LM Studio on this computer. Private, works offline
desc.acp: Any app that speaks the Agent Client Protocol
desc.other: A brain added by a plugin or for tests

brains.unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm sign-in. Run Test to be sure.

err.auth: Not signed in, or the sign-in expired. Sign in again.
err.limit: This account hit its usage limit. Try again later.
err.limitAt: This account hit its usage limit. It resets at {{time}}.
err.offline: Couldn't reach the brain. Check the internet, or that Ollama / LM Studio is open.
err.timeout: No answer within a minute. The app may be busy or stuck.
err.model: That model isn't available on this account. Pick another model.
err.busy: Too many tests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
err.failed: Couldn't run the test. Try again.
err.load: Couldn't load the brains. Try again.
